answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 35620 Country: India Title: Whether it is permissible in Shariah to wear red or maroon color clothes for men and boys Question: Whether it is permissible in Shariah to wear red or maroon color clothes for men and boys? Answer ID: 35620 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2018/1631/B=1432) It is makrooh for men and boys to wear purely red clothes. However it is allowed for women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
